limitations: Agent-reviewed synthetic labels; no human approval.
A ranking does not measure whether an agent abstains or answers correctly.
The 4 GiB limit is virtual address space, not a container RSS limit.
Dates and synthetic source paths are indexed identically in passage text.
Ranking is restricted to the query language; cross-language retrieval is not measured.
No model selection follows from this exploratory run.
Unreviewed synthetic labels are not ground truth about educational evidence.
No-answer cases are excluded from retrieval recall/MRR and require a separately supplied abstention decision.
Partial-answer cases cannot be scored by one abstention boolean and are excluded from that metric.
Hard-negative rates are diagnostic: a correct evidence set can contain a separately labelled outdated passage.
Results cover only submitted queries; report coverage before comparing systems.
